Upon closer inspection you saw a bunch of orcs chasing a wounded goblin, the goblin is carrying a lot of gold, which is fitting for a goblin. Goblin notices you and runs behind you, and you decide to take care of the orcs easily. The goblin thanked you and as you was continuing your journey, you noticed the goblin was following you.
